name: Vicky Hartzler
summary: Vicky Jo Hartzler (née Zellmer; born October 13, 1960) is an American politician and businesswoman who is serving as the Chair of the U.S. Commission on International Religious Freedom. She previously served as the U.S. representative for Missouri's 4th congressional district from 2011 to 2023. A member of the Republican Party, she served as the Missouri state representative for the 124th district from 1995 to 2001.
